caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bench rendered in a light brown color, shown at an angle that reveals both the front and one side. The bench features a straight seat with a matching backrest, both appearing to be made from flat, wide wooden planks. The backrest is attached to the seat by two supporting vertical boards, each slanted slightly outward. The seat itself is supported by two wide, flat legs with straight lines and sharp corners, and a lower supporting board mirroring the shape of the seat’s edge runs beneath. The bench's structural details include visible wood grain, lines indicating the planks' edges, and small dots resembling screws or nails. The background is an off-white color, and there are faint dashed guidelines and a measurement line labeled "10’" under the seat. The artist's signature is located in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Bench
